description: This PHP source file defines the 'OAuthSubscriber' class, which is an event subscriber for handling OAuth2 token validation and exceptions within the OrangeHRM application's OAuth plugin. It manages OAuth authorization during HTTP request events, handling token validation, user authentication, and error responses.

classes.name: OAuthSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber class that handles OAuth token validation and error processing during HTTP request and response events in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, mapping them to handler methods with their priority.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy-computes and returns an instance of the AuthenticationService.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests; performs OAuth token validation if authentication is not already established, setting user credentials accordingly.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Processes exceptions during OAuth validation, returning JSON error response if the request expects JSON, else throws session expired exception.

methods.name: onResponseEvent
methods.description: Handles outgoing responses; invalidates the session if OAuth authentication was successful.
